reviews.snippet: I just landed in Austin and boy was I hongry.  On the way to downtown the taxi passed this spot and so once I got checked in to the hotel, I started walking.  The convention center is now just a big hole in the ground and it’s kind of a shame that you can’t see more of the construction, but onwards towards barbecue.  This place did not disappoint.  It was precisely what I wanted.  You order at the counter, go to a second counter where they assemble your order, then take your treasure to a table.  There were big fans running to keep the air moving inside.  Remember we are talking August in Austin.  They had fountain Dr Pepper, cuz Texas.  The brisket was so tender, juicy and flavorful.  The potato salad was perfection.  And the green beans were excellent.  Throw in a slice of white bread, some pickle slices and onion slices and you have a complete culinary experience of the first order.  The only reason I took off one star for service was because I was serving myself and I was a little sloppy.
